title: Polynomial Split-Source Construction
statement: For every pair of natural numbers $C,e$, there exist a Boolean finite Turing machine $M$, a start state $s_0$ of $M$, and a function $B\colon\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{N}$ such that the machine produced by the split-solver construction at parameters $C,e$ is the loop controller whose body is the split-search body built from $M$ and $s_0$, with the specified length-counting fuel machine and anchor state. For every Boolean word $w$, running $M$ for $B(|w|)$ steps from its prescribed bank configuration with start state $s_0$ halts with output consisting of exactly $C(|w|+1)^e$ true bits, and for every $l\in\mathbb{N}$, $B(l)\le (C+1+5e)(l+1)^e+1$.
